we used single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) to identify and characterize the developmental trajectories of liver stem/progenitors cells (LSPC).

the dynamic developmental trajectories of liver stem/progenitors cells during mouse liver development.
the fate decision and differentiation trajectories of LSPC, and will help to better understand the molecular mechanisms of liver development.
the developmental trajectories of LSCPs, and the findings will provide new ideas for further studies on liver development.

our marker-free single-cell transcriptome analysis reveals the dynamic trajectories of LSPC differentiation and maturation, and provides valuable resources for future research on LSPCs.

The main takeaway from our work is that

single-cell transcriptomic profiling can be used to track the dynamic developmental trajectories of cells in the absence of a priori knowledge about cell type-specific markers, which could have important implications in the study of other stem/progenitor cell populations.
single-cell RNA sequencing can reveal developmental trajectories of LSCs and provide a valuable resource to study the developmental process of LSPCs.
